name: MCP Streamable HTTP Server Template
description: A dual-runtime template for building Model Context Protocol servers compatible with Node.js and Cloudflare Workers. It features integrated OAuth, encrypted token storage, and multi-tenant session management to simplify the creation of secure tool, resource, and prompt interfaces.

rawRecord.description: A dual-runtime template for building Model Context Protocol servers compatible with Node.js and Cloudflare Workers. It features integrated OAuth, encrypted token storage, and multi-tenant session management to simplify the creation of secure tool, resource, and prompt interfaces.

API_KEY.description: Static key used when AUTH_STRATEGY is set to 'api_key'.

BEARER_TOKEN.description: Static token used when AUTH_STRATEGY is set to 'bearer'.

CUSTOM_HEADERS.description: Custom headers configuration used when AUTH_STRATEGY is set to 'custom'.

RS_TOKENS_ENC_KEY.description: Encryption key for tokens, generated via 'openssl rand -base64 32 | tr -d '=' | tr '+/' '-_''

PROVIDER_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth client ID for the provider.

PROVIDER_ACCOUNTS_URL.description: The provider's accounts/auth base URL (e.g., https://accounts.spotify.com).

PROVIDER_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth client secret for the provider.
